choice.name: Choice
choice.description: One question with options: a vote, picking a topic, signing up for a slot
choice.limitHint: The limit is how many people may choose an option; 0 means no limit.
choice.allowMultiple: Allow choosing more than one option
choice.allowUpdate: Allow changing the answer while the choice is open
choice.showUnanswered: Show who has not answered yet
choice.showPreview: Show the options before it opens
choice.placesLeft: {count, plural, one {# place left} other {# places left}}
choice.closedNoAnswer: The choice is closed and you did not answer.
choice.answeredCount: {count, plural, one {# person answered} other {# people answered}}
choice.resultsAfterClose: Results appear when the choice closes.
choice.deleteConfirm: {count, plural, one {Delete the answer of # person?} other {Delete the answers of # people?}}
